department: Department of Chemical Engineering & Applied Chemistry

deadline.value: First round February 1 for September 2027 entry (second round March 15; January entry October 15).
deadline.quote: Fall (September) entry | February 1 (1st round of admission) | March 15 (2nd round of admission)

supervisor.value: An offer is made only when a professor agrees to supervise and fund you; contact potential supervisors early.
supervisor.quote: For MASc and PhD applicants, an offer of admission may only be considered when the applicant both meets admission requirements and has a faculty member that agrees to provide research supervision and financial support.

funding.value: Minimum base funding is guaranteed for 4 years (with a master's) or 5 years (direct entry from a bachelor's).
funding.quote: PhD students admitted with completed master's degree are guaranteed minimum base funding for their first 4 years. | Direct-entry PhD students admitted with a bachelor's degree are guaranteed minimum base funding for their first 5 years.

entry_route.value: Apply with a master's (B+) or directly from a bachelor's with an A- average in the last two years.
entry_route.quote: PhD Direct Entry A- average in the last two years of full-time study
